concerns.text: Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it creates the core directory layout that all subsequent tasks assume exists. Running T001 in parallel with any consumer (e.g., T003, T004, T005) could cause race conditions, violating the `[P]` guarantee that no hidden ordering is required.

Task T003 is also marked `[P]` while it implements Pydantic schemas that are imported by later tasks (e.g., T005, modeling scripts). If T003 runs concurrently with a consumer that imports the schemas before they are written, it creates an ordering dependency, making the `[P]` tag inaccurate.
